name: N9

images.credit: Animist, CC BY-SA 3.0 via Wikimedia Commons

Network.Technology: GSM 850 / 900 / 1800 / 1900, GPRS/EDGE class B, multislot class 33, HSDPA (Pentaband), HSDPA/UMTS 850 / 900 / 1700 / 1900 / 2100, HSDPA Cat10, up to 14.4 Mbps, HSUPA Cat6, up to 5.7 Mbps

Body.Dimensions: Width: 61.2 mm, Height: 116.45 mm, Thickness: 7.6 to 12.1 mm

Platform.CPU: 1 GHz ARM Cortex-A8 SoC processor; TI OMAP3630, 3D Graphics PowerVR SGX530 GPU, 430 MHz TI TMS320C64x Digital signal processor

Display.Display: "ClearBlack" AMOLED 854 × 480 px (FWVGA), 3.9" (99.1 mm), 16.7 million colors (24 bits)

Cameras.Rear camera: 8.7 MP (CMOS sensor of 1/3.0" size) with Carl Zeiss optics (F2.2, Focal length: 3.77mm / 28mm), 720p at 30 FPS, Digital zoom 4X for camera and video

Battery.Battery: BV-5JW 1450 mAh Li-Ion battery (removable by service), micro USB charging

Connectivity.Connectivity: WLAN IEEE 802.11 a/b/g/n (2.4 and 5GHz), bluetooth 2.1 +EDR (Hardware Supports 4.0, micro USB 2.0, GPS and A-GPS, 3.5 mm AV connector (audio in/out, video in/out, tv-set out)), Near Field Communication (NFC), Digital Living Network Alliance (DLNA), micro SIM card, FM receiver
